Date: Sun, 18 Oct 2026 08:12:00 -0400
Subject: Unexpected prorated charge after plan change

Hi Vanessa,

We noticed a ~€1,400 prorated charge on our October invoice after we switched from Standard to Business on 2026-10-01. The numbers on the invoice don't match the usage CSV you provided — in particular the streaming token counts for 10/01–10/03 look doubled in the billing ledger. Our finance team needs an explanation and confirmation of whether this is a metering issue before we can release payment.

Attaching the invoice PDF we received and a short sample export from our side (usage_sample_oct18.csv). Can you confirm whether Redwood applied a mid-cycle tier shift proration and how VAT was applied for our EU entity (we are registered in Ireland, VAT GB/EU questions)?

Thanks,
Claire Higgins

Hi Claire — thanks for flagging and for the attachments. Sorry for the friction here.

Quick summary of what I'll do immediately:
- Pull the invoice and raw metering logs for 2026-10-01 to 2026-10-03 and compare to your CSV.
- Confirm how the mid-cycle upgrade proration was calculated and whether VAT (Irish/VAT reverse-charge) was applied at invoice generation.
- If we find double-counted tokens we will propose a retroactive credit and outline the calculation.

Ben and Marissa — looping you in to triage the ledger and VAT treatment. Ben, can you pull the per-request IDs and any gateway replays for that 72h window? Marissa, finance may need to confirm tax treatment for ClearWave's EU registration.

Claire — can you confirm whether the usage_sample_oct18.csv came from your ingest logs (pre-sampling) or from your accounting export (post-aggregation)? That will help us align events.

I aim to have a preliminary update by EOD Monday (10/19).

Best,

If you can check per-request IDs around 2026-10-01T00:00–00:15Z that would be helpful.

Claire

From: ben.carter@redwood.ai
To: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 14:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Unexpected prorated charge after plan change

Vanessa, I pulled the logs for ClearWave for 2026-10-01 00:00Z–00:20Z and matched request IDs. There was a short overlap (00:04:48Z–00:07:12Z) where both the old and new routing policies accepted the same traffic due to a race during the rollout window. The serving runtime duplicated the rewrite rule for about 2m24s; resulting double-counting shows up in the ledger as duplicated streaming token tallies.

I attach a short evidence export (excerpt in the email body below) and the internal replay IDs. Proposed remediation:
- Issue a credit equal to the duplicated tokens * unit price for the time window (~€1,375 pre-VAT).
- Remove the duplicated ledger entries and regenerate a corrected invoice PDF.
- For VAT: since ClearWave is an EU-registered entity (Irish VAT), we'll zero-rate the credit and apply a corrected VAT line on the regenerated invoice. Marissa, please confirm tax handling.

Replay excerpt (request_id, timestamp, tokens):
- req_a7f9... , 2026-10-01T00:05:02Z, 4,832 tokens
- req_a7f9... , 2026-10-01T00:05:02Z, 4,832 tokens  <-- duplicate

Let me know if you want a deeper dump; I can provide full request IDs and hashes for audit.

Ben Carter
Billing Ops Manager, Redwood Inference

From: marissa.cole@redwood.ai
To: claire.h@clearwave.ai, vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai, ben.carter@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 09:31:00 +01:00
Subject: Re: Unexpected prorated charge after plan change

Claire — thanks for the context and thanks Ben for the root cause. We will: 
1) Apply a one-time credit of €1,375.00 to ClearWave's account (pre-VAT).
2) Regenerate the October invoice reflecting the corrected usage and VAT treatment (we will apply reverse-charge rules where appropriate for your Irish VAT ID).
3) Provide a short audit CSV showing removed ledger entries and the corrected token tallies.

Payment hold guidance: if you would like to hold the disputed portion while we finalize the regenerated invoice, we can mark the disputed amount in our portal and leave the undisputed remainder payable. Let us know how you'd like to proceed.

I'll drop the corrected invoice and audit export by close of day Wednesday (10/21).

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Senior Finance Manager, Redwood Inference

Claire — following up to confirm next steps:
- We have scheduled the regenerated invoice to be issued Wednesday EOD (10/21).
- Credit of €1,375.00 will be applied and the VAT line adjusted for your Irish VAT registration.
- If you prefer to split the payment, mark the disputed line in the portal and your collections contact will not pursue the disputed amount.

Please confirm if you want us to hold the disputed amount or if you will pay the undisputed balance now. Once you confirm, I will authorize the invoice to be sent to accounts@clearwave.ai.

Thanks again for the quick coordination — apologies for the rollout-induced duplication; we are updating the rollout checklist to prevent rewrites during traffic cutovers.

Best,
Vanessa
